definitions.explanation: The quality or degree of being safe. Used to discuss how safe something is, rather than the state of being safe.

examples.japanese: この{車|くるま}は{安全性|あんぜんせい}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: This car has a high level of safety.

examples.japanese: {食品|しょくひん}の{安全性|あんぜんせい}を{確認|かくにん}する。
examples.english: To verify the safety of food products.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{薬|くすり}の{安全性|あんぜんせい}が{確認|かくにん}されるまで{販売|はんばい}できない。
examples.english: The new medicine cannot be sold until its safety is confirmed.

notes:
{安全性|あんぜんせい} refers to the abstract quality or degree of being safe, used when discussing levels or assessments of safety rather than simply the state of being safe. It is formed from {安全|あんぜん} (safe) + {性|せい} (nature/quality), where the ～{性|せい} suffix converts adjectives or nouns into abstract quality nouns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {安全性|あんぜんせい}が{高|たか}い／{低|ひく}い — high/low safety
- {安全性|あんぜんせい}を{確保|かくほ}する — to ensure safety
- {安全性|あんぜんせい}を{確認|かくにん}する — to confirm safety
- {安全性|あんぜんせい}に{問題|もんだい}がある — there is a safety concern

CONTRAST WITH {安全|あんぜん}:
- {安全|あんぜん} — safe (state or condition)
- {安全性|あんぜんせい} — safety (the measurable quality/degree of being safe)
